quest.title: Witch's Homework: The Role of a Guide...?
quest.description: At the site of the mages' tea party, you meet Nicole, who seems to be talking to someone...
quest.rewards_formatted: Hero's Wit x3, Guide to Elysium x3, Mora x30000

chapter.title: Witch's Homework: The Role of a Guide...?

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: Leaving already? Hey, Barbie! Aren't you forgetting something? Like a whole bunch of stuff you were supposed to give...

choices.text: Is this a bad time...?

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: Nonsense, your arrival is more or less in line with Barbie's prophecy... Though to be honest, I did think you'd be here a little later.

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: Anyway... Before we get down to business, it might be best if you two... have something to eat?

choices.text: D—Did Barbeloth's prophecy say we'd be hungry?

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: No, of course not! But my hearing happens to be quite sharp, and I heard Paimon's stomach rumbling a mile away...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: *rumble* *rumble*

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whoa! Paimon's stomach is rumbling for two... We must both be super famished...

choices.text: How was I supposed to know that place would run out of steak...

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: Don't you worry about that! I've got plenty of cookies and cake — and as you know, nothing bad ever happened to hungry travelers who accepted food from a "witch"...

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: You and Paimon munch happily on cookies and cake while gulping down tea. Strangely, no matter how much you eat or drink, the teapot remains half full, and there is always a fresh cookie and slice of cake on your plates...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon's so full... No matter how much she puts in her tummy, there's always more on her plate...

choices.text: Is this what mages' tea parties are like...

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: Of course! You can't have a tea party without an ample supply of food and drink.

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: Though it's true, it is hard to display an appropriate "magely" elegance after stuffing one's face. That's why the teapot is usually only half full, and there's only one cookie or piece of cake on each plate.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon really can't eat any more! She's coming apart at the seams... Can we get down to business now? *burp* Oh... well, sorry...

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: Alright. I gather you're here to deliver my "homework" — the one that Barbie prophesied?

choices.text: You knew all along...

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: Nothing of the sort. We were discussing something completely different. The moon's massive shift has knocked her hydromancy out of whack, so she needs to head back for a while to undergo a period of silent meditation.

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: While she's away, I'll be taking over responsibility for everyone's homework. I also plan to help her add the next round of homework to the dictionary.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? You can just swap the person in charge like that!?

choices.text: Well, if anyone can do it...

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: Not like I had much choice! Before Barbie and Alice even told me about it, they'd already inscribed my "special homework" in the dictionary.

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: As much as I'd like to erase the whole thing and keep on casually observing the world, Alice is busy maintaining Teyvat's borders, and Barbie is off realigning her hydromancy...

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: Octavia didn't bother to come back, and you can forget about Rhinedottir... The other mages all have their own affairs to attend to, so the duty of supervising this homework has fallen to me.

choices.text: I didn't realize the Hexenzirkel was so busy...

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: There really are. I don't even know how long it's been since we all got together to make this a proper tea party.

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: In any case, as long as I finish my homework, my story will be officially inscribed in the dictionary.

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: #After that, I'll be able to go back to observing and guiding... So, {NICKNAME}, Paimon, it's time to deliver your message — what's my homework?

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: Oh, and since this doesn't count as a prophecy — just something Barbie and Alice came up with ten minutes ago — there probably isn't any useful information to be found in that dictionary you're carrying...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You're right, Nicole! We had a look before coming over, and there aren't any detailed instructions at all. There's only these two sentences...

choices.text: "Nicole will fulfill her duty."

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: Alright. That first sentence was clearly written by Barbie, but I'd bet my bottom Mora it was Alice who added the second.

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: Anyway, let's get cracking on this homework! Just let me think, where should we begin...

choices.text: Hold on, you actually understood what they want you to do?

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: Huh? Oh, Barbie gave me a rundown of my tasks just now.

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: Basically, I just need to go to a few homework locations, make sure everything's up to scratch, and conduct some fieldwork.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait a minute! Paimon thought she was giving you a prophecy? How does a "rundown" count as a prophecy?

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: Ah, well, you see, I naturally view anything Barbie says to me as some sort of prophecy.

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: Besides, when Barbie wrote this homework of mine, all she actually did was flip straight to the final page of my story and tell me the ending in advance.

choices.text: Isn't that a massive spoiler!?

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: Hmm... You make a fair point, but then what's the difference between a prophecy and a spoiler anyway? Alright, enough dawdling — come on, follow me. We're going to... Hmm, yes, that seems like as good a place as any...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Just like that? Hold on, how are we supposed to get the—

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: In the blink of an eye, you find yourselves standing at the edge of a cliff...

choices.text: Does this mean I came here for nothing...

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: What do you mean? This homework had to be delivered by you — that's a very important step. Certain formalities must be observed in order for homework to count.

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: But we can talk about that later. Anyway, enough dawdling — come on, follow me. We're going to... Hmm, yes, that seems like as good a place as any...

choices.text: I didn't understand a word of it...
"She definitely won't allow you to work for free!"
That's all there is.
Now you mention it, there's quite a lot of you.
...It's Nicole!
So just now, Barbeloth was...
We'll have to bring Varesa next time...

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: Is she the champion eater from Natlan's Collective of Plenty? Alice mentioned her to me once — apparently, she's a fascinating young lady.

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: I imagine if she were to attend one of our parties, we'd need to set out three... maybe even seven plates.

choices.text: We ate all that salad, but it just felt like a bowl of green air...
Is hunger something that can be prophesied, too?
Maybe we should come back later...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: In the blink of an eye, you find yourselves standing at the edge of a cliff...

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: Alright, we're here. This Seelie Court has some really great views, don't you think? See that spot over there? That's the starting point.

choices.text: ...Seelie Court?

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: Did I use it to get us here faster? You bet I did! These Seelie Courts are connected to the Ley Lines, and nobody really uses them. They're very handy when it comes to traveling about.

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: Besides, the Seelie and I used to be angels, so we're old colleagues. I'm sure they won't mind me borrowing their homes every once in a while.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: There doesn't seem to be anyone else around...

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: We're early. In but a short while, a bard will come to sing odes of old and call back the thousand winds that wander the ages...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I don't suppose this homework is for...

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: Shh... Patience. All will be revealed in time. Before long, you will become a single lilting melody ensconced in an ode, and the thousand winds will swirl around you.

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: But before that happens, we should allow it to slumber in peace... Come, let's head to our next location.

choices.text: Hey, isn't this...

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: Yes, I read about that in the dictionary. Based on how it ended, you and Lord Barbatos must have played quite a beautiful tune. Such a shame that Barbie couldn't hear a single note.

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: When Alice heard about it, she laughed so hard her hat nearly fell off. Ahem! How about we head to the next location! Which should be...

choices.text: Venti and I once performed a duet on that island in the distance.
Did you just use it to...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Is this Wolvendom? Doesn't seem like the best place for doing "homework"...

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: This is the nearest Seelie Court to where we're going. Don't worry, we're not far from the starting point.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa! Where did all those wolves jump out from!? Hey... We're not here to hurt you! We're friends with Razor...

choices.text: The wolves have gone...

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: Shh. Has that child not arrived yet? Perhaps we've come too early again. Not to worry, as long as he stands beside his "lupical", he can overcome any foe.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Why've they come back? Did they hear us talking? If only Razor were here, he'd be able to tell us what they want to say...

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: You're not wrong, Paimon, but there's a lot more he'd need to understand than just the chatter of wolves...

choices.text: Hey, isn't this...

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: That's right. That child already claimed victory in the battle he was destined to fight.

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: As long as he stands beside his "lupical", I believe he can overcome any foe.

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: ...I'm sure his lupical feels the same way, too.

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: Alright! That's about it for this place. I could do with a good rest. Come on, let's go. Time to head back for a cup of—

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whoa! When did this door appear!?

choices.text: There's a note stuck to it...

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: This looks like Alice's handwriting. Let's take a look...

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: "Thanks for your help with the homework! Now hurry home and have a hot cup of tea!"

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: "P.S. There is a surprise waiting behind this door!"

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: Hurry home? Wait a second, why does this door look so familiar? There's no way it could lead to...

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Nicole pushes the door open, then strides through purposefully as you follow. A moment later, you find yourselves standing inside a room...

choices.text: This style... It feels familiar...
Razor and I once fought here together.
I don't suppose this homework is for...

dialogues.speaker: Read Alice's note...
dialogues.text: "Thanks for your help with the homework! Now hurry home and have a hot cup of tea!"

dialogues.speaker: Read Alice's note...
dialogues.text: "P.S. There is a surprise waiting behind this door!"

choices.text: Hold on, over there...

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: No wonder Alice wanted to borrow the lodge key... She said she wanted to set up a tea room, even though I told her I already had one...

choices.text: So this is a gift from Alice?

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: It symbolizes "the completion of guidance," "the end of a journey," and "the fulfillment of prophecy."

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: You've followed Seelie before, right? Only when a Seelie returns to its Seelie Court does its guidance come to an end.

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: So, to give this unwelcome homework a clear conclusion, Barbie and Alice must have built a Seelie Court right here.

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: This is the only way for my story to be inscribed among everyone else's without interfering with their own homework.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: But you're not a Seelie, are you?

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: Ah... Uhm, well, we're not all that different. Once upon a time, we were all angels, after all... But that doesn't really matter. What's important is what it symbolizes.

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: It's like writing a novel. As long as the main outline is there, there'll always be a way to flesh out the details so the pieces fall into place.

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: As long as I take my seat, this homework of mine will be officially over...

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: It's a nice touch, but it feels like... the ending to a story written on the fly. If Anya were here, I'm sure she'd have come up with something more clever...

choices.text: I see...

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: Don't you worry, that's an essential element as well...

response.speaker: #Paimon & {NICKNAME}
response.text: Hey, a treasure chest!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Hey, a treasure chest!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Now this homework's starting to make sense!

choices.text: So this is what it feels like when the pieces all fall into place...

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: What did I tell you? It seems like this has been a fruitful little excursion after all!

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: Ahem... And it seems my story has been formally inscribed in the dictionary.

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: Which means... that today's homework ends here, and also, that there'll be a formal tutor to provide guidance on all future assignments.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: ...Will there be more chests for those assignments, too?

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: Well, that depends on what assignments are... assigned.

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: Personally, I'd love nothing more than to bury chests for people to find by completing their homework. I'd leave clues and watch them enjoy a merry little treasure hunt... Now that would be fun!

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: *sigh* But Barbie's been keeping a close eye on me, so I'm not sure I'll get the chance...

choices.text: Guess the outline really is key!
And here was me thinking it would end with a treasure chest...
But why would she give you a Seelie Court...?
There's a huge Seelie Court in here!

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: Anyway... My "guidance" doesn't end until you open that chest! For the sake of the dictionary, can you please see what's inside?

dialogues.speaker: Leave
dialogues.text: (The lock won't budge at all. Perhaps you should open Nicole's treasure chest first...)

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: Hey! The chest's over here, you two!
